purpose: Teach: 尋常/行き着く/電報/航路/探知/重傷/覇権/代議士

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんの容体、本気で、絶対、尋常ではなく、絶対、医療、絶対、緊張、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren — the patient's condition is serious. I'm genuinely grateful for your attention to this.
lines.style: Steady, clear delivery. No rush. Clinical precision without coldness. Eye-contact level held throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんの治療、本気で、絶対、最終的に、絶対、行き着く、絶対、結果、絶対、見守りたいですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I'd like to watch how the treatment unfolds to its conclusion, Dr. Saito. Thank you for explaining it so carefully.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft, genuine curiosity layered under. Slight lean forward — engaging, not performing. Ends with quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。昔の医療、本気で、絶対、電報で、絶対、緊急連絡、絶対、していた、絶対、時代がありました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. In earlier medical practice, we would have sent urgent telegrams to coordinate care across distances.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact historical tone. Each sentence lands with quiet weight. Unhurried — giving him room to absorb the weight of what's changed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療搬送、本気で、絶対、航路、絶対、最短経路を、絶対、選びますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So medical transport would choose the fastest route available, wouldn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine question delivered without hesitation. Engaged but not pushy. The rhythm suggests he's thinking through it aloud with her, not testing her knowledge.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。最新の、本気で、絶対、探知機器、絶対、医療現場、絶対、活用しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Modern detection equipment has become central to how we coordinate care in these situations.
lines.style: Measured, informative. Pride beneath the professionalism — not in herself but in what medicine can now do. Steady breathing, no urgency.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 重傷の患者さん、本気で、絶対、本当に、絶対、辛い状況、絶対、ですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Cases with severe injury are so difficult to navigate, aren't they, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet recognition of weight. Not seeking reassurance but acknowledging shared understanding. Soft, almost to himself — then a small lift at the end to include her.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療技術の覇権、本気で、絶対、各国、絶対、競っている時代、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Countries are competing right now over medical technology advancement — it matters at every level.
lines.style: Patient explanation. A light emphasis on the scale of it — not alarm, just clarity. Resting into the reality of what she's describing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 代議士、本気で、絶対、医療政策、絶対、本気で、検討、絶対、必要ですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Policy makers really do need to give serious thought to medical infrastructure questions like these, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful conclusion. Reflective — he's connecting personal care to systemic need. Measured pace. Ends with a note of quiet conviction, not demand.
